# ScriptClientEntity

*Client*

An entity as the client of this player sees it, e.g. the subject of a client event. Changes made through it are local: other players do not see them.

## Methods

### getMinecraftEntity {#getminecraftentity}

::: member

**Returns** `T` — the Minecraft entity, for Java code

:::

### setGlowing {#setglowing}

::: member

Shows or hides the glowing outline of the entity on this client only.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `glowing` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the outline is shown |

:::

### getName {#getname}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — shown name: the custom name if it has one, else the player name or the name of the entity type

:::
